title: Split Filter Controller Content controls
description: Refactor includes/Elementor/FilterController/ContentControls.php into bounded target listing, filter repeater, sort, pagination, state, and preset controls.
objective: Reduce Content controls before adding more field-source and per-filter configuration behavior.
expected_outputs: Content control modules by target, filter repeater, sort, pagination, and state
acceptance_criteria: No Elementor content control ID is renamed.
No saved widget setting shape changes.
Each content control module stays below the plugin line budget.
verification: php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes or reports only tracked transition debt.
risks: Control order can drift during extraction.
Saved Elementor data can break if IDs are renamed.
Style cadence can regress if content control grouping changes unexpectedly.
